channel.title: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
channel.description: Breaking news and world news from France 24 on Business, Sports, Culture. Video news. News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America

item.title: US midterms: Trump reacts to the Democrats’ sweeping victory
item.description: US President Donald Trump had rare praise for rival Democrats Tuesday after their stunning US midterm elections victory and admitted the Iran war may have played a part in the defeat of his Republican Party. But the 80-year-old refused to take any personal responsibility for the result.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ethiopia expands hydropower ambitions
item.description: Ethiopia is looking to position itself as an African leader in clean energy, as it prepares to host next year’s COP32 climate summit. Alongside the GERD, the country is building another massive hydropower project on the Omo River in the southwest, as it expands electricity production and exports power to neighbouring countries. This report from our correspondent Tom Canetti.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: From Kansas to Texas, Democrats win big in Republican heartlands
item.description: The Democrats are set to take control of both the House and the Senate following victories in states like South Carolina, Kansas, and Texas, whose switching blue constitutes an historic upset. President Donald Trump has said he will accept the results and blames the candidates themselves for the losses.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: US midterms bring surge of historic firsts for women and members of minority groups
item.description: The 2026 US midterm elections will go down in history for the Democrats' dramatic takeover of both houses of Congress but also for a surge of historic firsts for women, LGBT, Black, and Native American candidates, as well as the election the first Muslim US senator.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: South Korea pushes digital detox for young people addicted to screens
item.description: Back in August, France's Constitutional Council overturned a social media ban for children under 15. Some students, though, are now banned from using their smartphones at school. In South Korea, where an estimated 40 percent of young children and teens are addicted to their mobile devices, authorities are trying to find ways to drastically reduce their screen time – a huge challenge in such a hyper-connected society. FRANCE 24's Chloé Borgnon, Aruna Popuri and Justin McCurry report.
item.dc:creator: Chloé BORGNON

item.title: Midterms: Trump acknowledges role of Iran war, congratulates Dems
item.description: President Donald Trump acknowledged on Wednesday that the US-Israeli war on ​Iran ‌played a role in his party's sweeping ⁠defeat in the midterm elections, as Democrats won control of the House of ‌Representatives and the Senate. "I think a part of it ⁠was Iran," Trump told Fox News in an interview in which he also praised the Democrats for their campaign. France 24's Wassim Cornet has more.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: US voters back abortion rights and reject Trump's gerrymandering in state ballot measures
item.description: US voters in several states pushed back on President Donald Trump’s redistricting efforts and backed abortion rights in 145 ballot questions during the midterm elections. Some measures put Trump’s priorities to a public test by gauging support for his attempts to redraw congressional districts, limit reproductive rights and strengthen voter identification requirements.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Markets react with caution to Democrats' victory in US midterms
item.description: Investors shunned AI stocks and turned to government bonds on Wednesday in the wake of the Democratic Party's takeover of Congress in the US midterm elections. Oil prices meanwhile ticked slightly higher, as uncertainty remains over the direction of US President Donald Trump's war against Iran. Also in this edition, we focus on the central issue of this midterm campaign: the rise in the cost of living.
item.dc:creator: Charles PELLEGRIN

item.title: Champions League: Paris Saint-Germain make easy work of Villarreal
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain made easy work of Villarreal in the Champions League (6-0). The game was decided after 17 minutes and four goals.
item.dc:creator: L'Equipe TV

item.title: DR Congo residents sue Chinese mining giant for widespread pollution
item.description: In Kolwezi, the mining capital of the Democratic Republic of Congo, local residents are suing a huge Chinese mine and the government for environmental pollution. It will be one of the most important cases the country has seen. FRANCE 24's correspondent Emmet Livingstone reports.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24
